changes_from_exp018: Control retains the velocity MSE and exact-t0 ILM-OPL maximum projection L1.
Layer arm adds ILM-OPL/OPL-BM/ILM-BM mean projection L1, coefficient0.1 each.
Both arms select best by equal mean of ILM-OPL max SSIM and three layer-mean SSIMs.
Both use float32 tensors, TF32 allowed, benchmark on, AMP/scaler off.
Both retain validation metrics and 2D evidence, releasing intermediate validation 3D arrays.
implementation_reuse: fm3d from exp102, same exp018 base16 generator and Euler8 stitched inference
halo-blocked exact-neighborhood SSIM reused from exp156

reference.title: XOCT: Enhancing OCT to OCTA Translation via Cross-Dimensional Supervised Multi-Scale Feature Learning
reference.basis: Section3.1 Eq1 layer-specific mean projection. Project uses paired FM and L1 supervision.
reference.project_choices: per-mean coefficient0.1, exact-t0 timing, Z256 center rasterization, four-view selection, fixed split

delivery: self-contained source and annotations, directory sync, no training launch or upload
